measurement.K: BK * pipeline_loop_count; calibration only, no MNK workload optimization
measurement.timing: Median; slope (cycles64-cycles16)/48; intermediate residual relative to long-run cycles <=0.02
measurement.utilization: 2*BM*BN*BK / cycles_per_bk_slope / 4096; useful arithmetic fraction, not a hardware busy counter
measurement.accuracy: Full-output comparison against CPU FP32 reference, random seed29 scale1, atol=rtol=1e-3
measurement.promotion: New continuation winners require >=3% improvement in initial and fresh independent run, identical full assembly and steady 16/32/64 slopes; historical steady-only rows retain their weaker evidence label
